ruleDefinitions.name: Publisher Attachment File Dropped In Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of files with the ".pub" extension in suspicious or uncommon locations. This could be a sign of attackers abusing Publisher documents

sequences.query: ((file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) AND file_path = RGX("\\\.pub$"))
